title: Diagnose, quarantine, and safely replay poison queue work
trigger: The same background job fails deterministically across retries while the RabbitMQ broker and worker consumer remain healthy.
preconditions: capture the affected request ID, event/message ID, ticket or business object reference, queue state, and worker consumer count
confirm the failure is message-scoped rather than a broad dependency or worker outage
confirm retry behavior is bounded and a durable quarantine path exists
preserve the original payload and headers for investigation
diagnostic_steps: correlate repeated job_failed events for the same request/message ID
compare observed attempts with the configured retry ceiling
confirm one or more healthy messages still complete through the same consumer
verify API, PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, and worker health
confirm the poison message is moved to quarantine exactly once after retry exhaustion
inspect quarantine payload and headers before deciding whether replay is safe
identify whether the defect is malformed data, unsupported event type, stale reference, or another permanent contract violation
mitigation_steps: do not restart a healthy worker to treat a message-specific failure
do not purge the main or quarantine queue
do not return an unchanged poison message to the main queue
keep the message quarantined when ownership or correction is uncertain
escalate producer/application contract defects to the owning team with payload and retry evidence
only after an approved correction, replay the corrected message once with preserved correlation metadata and reset retry state
validation_steps: healthy work continues to complete while the poison message is quarantined
the poison message no longer consumes retry capacity on the main queue
quarantine retains exactly the expected message before remediation
corrected replay produces exactly one successful completion for the affected request
the original affected ticket or business object reaches the expected completed state
main and quarantine queues return to expected steady state
worker/API runtime identities remain unchanged when restart or redeployment was not required
escalation_boundary: Escalate whenever the payload cannot be safely corrected within documented L2 authority, the producer contract is unclear, repeated poison messages indicate a systemic producer defect, quarantine growth threatens capacity, or replay requires code/schema/business-data changes.
